summary: Formats a scaled setup value as "%d %s" into a caller-supplied buffer. Builds the value as (a2[5]*a2[2] + a2[0]) * 0.001, optionally applies a ~5.710147155067049 degree-conversion factor when the format flag at this+4 equals 1, then calls StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck with the value and the unit string at this+56.

operations.description: Compute scaled value v3 = ((int)(a2+20) * (double)(a2+8) + (double)a2[0]) * 0.001 from the base, multiplier, and index operands.
Guard on format flag at this+4 == 1; only then is the degree-conversion factor applied.
When the flag passes, multiply v3 by 5.710147155067049 to convert to the degree-based unit.
Format the truncated integer value and the unit string at this+56 into the output buffer a2+30 via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck using the "%d %s" format.
Return the result of the StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck call.
